states.visualChange: One localized failure makes the barrier visibly weaker while the chassis, footprint and repair affordance remain unmistakably usable. One panel drops, opens or shifts along a plausible joint. One frame or bracket break exposes bare structure without creating a full passage.
invariants: Dimensions, footprint, pivot and front orientation remain fixed across territories and states.
The structural frame, two-foot grounding logic and three-bay rhythm remain recognizable.
The player interaction point remains on the safe rear side at the same gameplay anchor.
Damage never moves the collision footprint or invents detached gameplay-blocking fragments.
Component IDs and effect anchors remain stable across regeneration.
